title: Cage of Causality
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's fingertips touched the turning point of fate, a crack suddenly tore open in the void. A figure draped in ink-black robes stepped out slowly, holding an ink-black brush in hand—the legendary "Scribe of Destiny," the being tasked with recording the fate of cultivators.

text.content: The Tianji mark on his brow center burned like fire, threatening to ignite his entire soul. A residual shadow from ten thousand years ago hovered silently before him—bearing an identical face to Chen Ji, yet etched with a profound age and determination he had never possessed. Countless tiny light specks drifted through the void like fireflies, each representing a recorded fate, a life consumed by the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "You claim to be me, but why should I believe you?" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the empty void, carrying a tremor he himself had not noticed. "What did you do ten thousand years ago? Why pass this burden to me?"

text.content: The shadow slowly closed its eyes, and the surrounding light specks began to spin faster, forming a massive vortex. Chen Ji felt his Tianji mark resonate, and in that moment, he saw—he saw that night ten thousand years ago, saw a figure identical to himself standing atop the altar, with countless cultivators kneeling at his feet.

dialogue.content: "That day, I used the Tianji Record to deduce the complete layout of the Ultimate Chess Player." The shadow opened its eyes, its gaze reflecting the scenes of that time. "The three great sects, the Demonic Path invasion, the Ancient Forbidden Land—these were merely pieces casually placed by Him. And you and I, we were always nothing more than the nutrients He wished to devour."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Those chess games he thought he had meticulously arranged, those calculations he believed were perfectly hidden—were they all from the very beginning placed upon someone else's chessboard? This realization struck like a basin of ice water poured over his head, nearly freezing all the blood in his body.

dialogue.content: "So you chose sacrifice?" Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold. "Trading ten thousand years of reincarnation for a chance to defeat Him?" The shadow smiled bitterly: "I had no choice. He was too powerful, powerful enough that any direct confrontation was meaningless. Only by making fate itself a weapon..."

text.content: Inside the vortex, the scene suddenly shifted. Chen Ji saw countless fragments of himself, saw the scattered Tianji Record fragments, saw those pieces he had collected and merged gradually assembling completely. And at the moment each fragment merged, a faint thread was drawn from his body, flowing into the invisible depths of the sky.

dialogue.content: "Do you understand now?" The shadow's voice grew deeper. "Every time you use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, you prove to the Ultimate Chess Player—that you are alive, that you have value. And what He needs is precisely this nourishment from fate itself." Chen Ji felt a wave of nausea; he finally understood the true meaning of the Heavenly Fate consumption.

text.content: "So the more complete the Tianji Record becomes, the closer I am to death?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. "Is this the so-called inevitable backlash?" The shadow nodded: "The Tianji Record is the shackle He bestowed upon you, but also the only hope I left you. The day you complete it is when you face Him directly—and that is the end of your fate."

dialogue.content: "Then why should I accept?" Chen Ji raised his head sharply, his eyes burning with rage. "Since everything was designed, I will break it! I don't need the Tianji Record, I refuse to accept this fate!" The shadow watched him silently, its gaze containing both gratification and infinite sorrow.

text.content: "Break it?" The shadow repeated softly. "Do you think the Tianji Record is merely a book or a magical treasure? No, it is a mark carved deep into your soul. Without it, your foresight will collapse instantly, your cultivation will regress by thirty percent, and more importantly—" The shadow paused. "Your sister Chen Nian, the Heavenly Fate Key within her will completely lose control."

This name pierced Chen Ji's heart like a blade. Niannian—his sister missing for years, taken by the Holy Sect to serve as a Heavenly Fate Key. He had been searching for her, using the Tianji Record to locate her. Only now did he realize that every search was pushing her into more danger.

choice.prompt: The shadow from ten thousand years ago reached out, and a blurry scene materialized in its palm—Chen Nian trapped somewhere. The shadow's voice seemed to come from beyond the nine heavens: "The choice is yours, Chen Ji. Walk this path to its end, trading your life for hers; or sever all causality now, living forever apart."

choices.description: Accept the fate set by himself ten thousand years ago, continue collecting Tianji Record fragments, and confront the Ultimate Chess Player at fate's end. The cost is inevitable backlash, the reward is the possibility of completely defeating the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Completely defeat the Ultimate Chess Player, save Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: This is a path destined for death

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his gaze held a tranquil determination. "I choose this path." His voice did not tremble in the slightest. "Since the you from ten thousand years ago has already laid the road, I will walk it to the end."

dialogue.content: A bitter smile appeared at the corner of the shadow's lips: "Good. But before you make the final decision, there are things you must know—about Su Qingyao, about Ye Qing, about those allies you thought you recruited yourself..."

choices.description: Abandon the foresight brought by the Tianji Record, sever the causal connection with the Ultimate Chess Player, living forever apart. The cost is losing foresight, regression in cultivation, and never rescuing Chen Nian; the reward is surviving and living freely thereafter.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Tianji Record, unable to rescue Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Preserve life, break free from the Ultimate Chess Player's control

text.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his knuckles white from the strain. He thought of Su Qingyao, of her gaze time and again approaching the truth only to be deflected by him; of Ye Qing, the Demonic Path Saintess who, after being shocked by his prophecy, chose to cooperate. If he chose freedom, what would become of them?

dialogue.content: "If I sever causality," Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, "what will happen to Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and all those drawn into this chess game because of me?" The shadow was silent for a moment: "They will continue along their original fate's trajectory until they are devoured by the Ultimate Chess Player one by one."

choices.text: Question the shadow, seek a third path
choices.description: Reject the two predetermined options, and with Chen Ji's characteristic strategy of meticulous planning, demand more information from the shadow, attempting to find a path that can both defeat the Ultimate Chess Player and preserve himself.

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes—that unique glow belonging to him alone, the light of meticulous strategy. "You say I am your hope," he said slowly, "yet from beginning to end, you have told me only two paths—death, or surviving in cowardice. This does not sound like words from someone who has been scheming for ten thousand years."

dialogue.content: For the first time, an expression changed on the shadow's face. In those eyes identical to Chen Ji's, a light Chen Ji had never seen before flickered—it was hope, admiration, and a deeply hidden pride. "You are indeed me... no, you have done better than me."

text.content: The shadow's form began to grow fainter, as if it might dissipate into this void at any moment. Its gaze at Chen Ji became infinitely complex—guilt, expectation, and a weight of trust spanning ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: "Whatever you choose," the shadow's voice grew lighter, "remember one thing—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. Its strength comes from all cultivators' reverence for fate, and what you must do is let everyone know that fate can be rewritten." As the words fell, the shadow completely transformed into scattered light specks, merging into Chen Ji's brow center.

text.content: In that moment, the Tianji mark on Chen Ji's brow erupted with unprecedented brilliance. Countless scenes surged into his mind like a tide—he saw Su Qingyao practicing sword alone at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, saw Ye Qing in a dangerous situation being besieged by many at the Demonic Path Holy Sect, saw the狰狞 face hidden beneath Ling Yuan's kind facade. And at the deepest point of all those scenes, he saw a pair of eyes—eyes that were watching him.

dialogue.content: It was a gaze impossible to describe in words, simultaneously like a high-and-mighty deity overlooking ants, and like an invisible hand reaching out from the abyss. Chen Ji felt every thought, every breath of his being perceived by those eyes. In that instant, he understood what "Ultimate Chess Player" meant, what "Heavenly Eye" meant.

text.content: But Chen Ji did not retreat. He slowly raised his head, staring directly at those eyes existing in the mysterious beyond. Even a cold smirk tugged at the corner of his mouth. From the first day he entered the cultivation world, he had been hiding his true strength, playing the role of a insignificant trash before everyone. But now, for the first time, he felt—it was time to show his real fangs.

"You think I am a chess piece?" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the void, carrying an unprecedented certainty. "Then I will overturn this game." The moment his words fell, the entire void trembled violently. Cracks spread from all directions. And within those cracks, Chen Ji saw—a figure draped in ink-black robes, holding an ink-black brush, slowly stepping out from the depths of the fissure.

"Interesting." The figure's voice was like an ancient whisper. "Ten thousand years, and finally someone dares to look directly at me." The Scribe of Destiny had finally appeared, witnessing Chen Ji's moment of choice. And this was only the beginning.
